whatThisIs: Consumption of the six completed batch-acquisition runs: per-run execution proof and per-source COMPLETE/PARTIAL/REFUSED results read from the GitHub Actions job logs through the API. A workflow conclusion of success is never treated as an acquisition result; only the summarize job's verdict and each acquire job's own receipt lines are.
howResultsWereRead: Acquisition artifacts are not downloadable from this container (the egress proxy answers CONNECT 403 for the GitHub artifact blob host), so results were consumed from job logs: each run's 'Batch result' job prints the summarizer verdict line 'COMPLETE|PARTIAL|REFUSED: N/M acquired ...' plus one FAILED line per failure, and each acquire job prints 'OK acquired <jur> <form>' with final URL, HTTP status, byte length, sha256, structural class and 'expected hash MATCHES|DOES NOT MATCH', or 'FAIL official-source acquisition — <reason>'.

promo.mechanism: scripts/rcap-materialize-acquisition-handoff.mjs — requires the exact artifact body (--input), its receipt (--receipt), the run id and the artifact name, and refuses any promotion whose receipt outcome is not exactly 'acquired' or whose pinned/observed hashes do not all bind.
promo.whatIsMissingPerRow: the artifact zip bytes. Every one of the fifteen bound sources has run id 33449768535, a planner-derived artifact name, a retained artifact (IDs recorded above, 30-day retention from 2026-08-31), and a receipt whose observed sha256 equals the manifest pin — but the artifact download host (productionresultssa*.blob.core.windows.net, signed URL obtained via the API) is refused by this container's egress proxy with CONNECT 403, and the acquire script's fallback transport (receipt + base64 bytes in GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY) is not exposed through any API surface reachable here (the job's check-run output is empty).
verifiedBlocks: actions_get download_workflow_run_artifact for artifact 9779344986 returned a signed productionresultssa12.blob.core.windows.net URL; curl through the proxy: 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403'
get_check_run 99676956206 returned output.summary and output.text empty — job step summaries are not served by the Checks API
promo.rowDiscipline: Each of the fifteen rows is STOPPED on exactly this missing input; the lane continues. No hash was carried forward as custody, no body was committed, no family is released.
promo.whoCanPromote: Any environment that can reach the artifact store — the captain's host, or a hosted job that downloads the artifacts and runs the materializer — using: node scripts/rcap-materialize-acquisition-handoff.mjs --run-id 33449768535 --artifact-name <name> --input <extracted body> --receipt <extracted receipt.json> --expected-sha256 <the manifest pin recorded above>.
promo.retentionDeadline: artifacts expire 30 days after 2026-08-31; promotion after ~2026-09-30 requires a fresh batch run

grantsNothing: A consumed receipt is a consumed receipt. Nothing here promotes custody, builds a packet, releases a family or opens a commercial route.
